title: LFO VELOCITY + HUM
author: jack
description: MIDI track LFO: the destination that was Aftertouch now modulates note velocity (shown as SRC:Velocity in the list and VEL on the knob; the MIDI Source page AT knob also reads VEL). No aftertouch messages are sent by the LFO. HUM (knob E on the MIDI TRIG page, 0-60): random velocity of -HUM..+HUM per trig, same for all notes of a chord; press knob E to reset. With HUM on, two trigs in a row are always at least 15 apart in velocity.
